info.title: Dataset Service API
info.description: Dataset archives, imports and images. Public datasets allow anonymous reads. User API keys use dataset scopes; pipeline keys read public datasets and datasets belonging to their project owner.

tags.name: Datasets
tags.description: Dataset ownership, archives and imported items

source.description: Set when the dataset lives on the Hugging Face Hub. Visin keeps only this pointer; the zip below, if any, is the local copy. Absent means the zip kept here is the dataset.

revision.description: The full commit hash, never a branch or tag.

data.description:
How to fetch the dataset. With a Hub `source`, download it from the Hub at `source.revision`
and use the zip (`downloadUrl`) only as the fallback. A dataset on the Hub alone has no
`downloadUrl`, `filename`, `size` or `expiresAt`.

revision.description: What a client that follows `source` records as the version it used - the Hub commit - or, without a source, the archive's upload time.

archiveRevision.description: Version of the archive addressed by `downloadUrl`. Record this one when falling back to the zip.

get.summary: What the Hub says about a dataset's repo
get.description:
For a dataset with a Hugging Face `source`: the repo's card fields, size, top-level folders (where the splits
usually are) and first files, read from the Hub's API at the pinned commit. Nothing is copied. Only public
repos can be read: a private or missing one answers `404`. Answers are kept for an hour. A dataset with no
`source` answers `400`.

200.description: The repo as the Hub describes it

truncated.description: More files than the first hundred listed.

400.description: The dataset is not kept on the Hub

403.description: The caller may not read the dataset

404.description: The repo or commit is missing or private
